meta.title: C-Drive Escape Cleaner
meta.description: Keeps AI toolchain cache and temp writes off the C: drive: redirects TEMP/pip/uv/HuggingFace/Torch/npm/Playwright cache variables to an escape root on another drive, watches the C: directories toolchains leak into, classifies every candidate as safe-to-delete / cache / locked, and cleans only what is provably safe — recycle bin by default.
